$comment: Pricing scaffold. Values live in config rather than code so they can change without a deploy, and so nothing on the scoring path can import them — packages/rubric has no dependency on this file and would fail to compile if it did.

tiers.label: Free
tiers.contents: One limited report per app per 90 days. Headline score and top three findings. No evidence artefacts, no badge.

tiers.label: One-off deep report
tiers.contents: Full findings with evidence, remediation guide, improvement suggestions, store-readiness checklist, PDF export, one free re-test within 30 days.

tiers.label: Certified
tiers.contents: Badge, monthly re-assessment, drift alerts, trend history.

tiers.label: Agency
tiers.contents: Multi-app workspace, seats, white-label PDF export.

tiers.label: Organisation
tiers.contents: SSO, policy profiles, portfolio dashboard, audit export.
